title: TrustAssessment
description: The computed trust state of one claim at one point in time. DERIVED, never author-supplied, and recomputable from the record and its evidence — a stored value that disagrees with recomputation is a defect, not a fact. A level may be reduced retroactively (for example when an issuer is found fraudulent); reassessment supersedes, and the prior assessment stays visible.

subject_ref.description: The Fact, Event or Credential this assesses.

level.description: Substantive corroboration. T0 self-declared, T1 documented, T2 professionally verified, T3 institutional.

anchoring_state.description: ORTHOGONAL to level — 'T4' in prose. Answers a DIFFERENT question: has this record been altered since it was written? It does not answer whether the claim is true. An anchored T0 claim remains a self-declaration. Implementations MUST expose level and anchoring_state as two separate values, and MUST NOT render an anchor as a verification badge, checkmark or 'verified' label.

rationale.description: Why this level was computed. Must be sufficient to reproduce the computation.

supersedes.description: A prior assessment this one replaces. The prior assessment is retained and remains visible.

reduction_reason.description: Set when this assessment lowers a previously higher level.
